budget: EUR budget for the period (preference, not a price estimate)
allergies: Allergies: comma separated, or - for none
help_text: AI chooses dishes. Nutrition is calculated locally from your catalog. Import Excel or demo first. Food preferences are sent to OpenRouter without Telegram ID or name. Your menu changes only after confirmation. The period starts on Monday; household portions apply after saving. Check ingredients for allergies.
preview_note: Nutrition for one portion; household overrides apply in the saved menu.
error.not_configured: AI is not configured. Ask the administrator to set OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
error.catalog: First import a menu with ingredients using Excel or demo (up to 300 products).
error.restriction: Restrictions cannot be verified safely or were violated. Use precise catalog ingredient names.
error.ingredients: Could not resolve ingredients. Try different parameters.
error.target: Could not safely scale portions to your target. Change parameters.
error.stale: Preview expired or access denied. Reopen AI Menu.
error.input: Invalid value. Check range and length.
error.provider: AI service is temporarily unavailable. Try later.
error.auth: OpenRouter authentication failed. Contact the administrator.
error.rate_limit: OpenRouter rate limit reached. Try later.
error.model: Model unavailable or JSON Schema unsupported.
error.invalid_response: AI returned an invalid response. Menu unchanged.
